neighbours.label: the comma or parenthesis that closes a clause naming the top-ranked item (the most common X, the highest number of Y), where a runner-up or count follows, as against the same clause without a ranking
fire: Back pain was the most frequent complaint among the drivers (38 percent), followed by neck strain.
Germany sent the largest number of athletes to the games, with 412 in total.
Wheat is the most widely grown crop in the province, followed by barley and oats.
Lisbon had the highest number of tourist visits last year, with almost six million.
Theft was the most commonly reported crime in the district (52 cases), followed by vandalism.
The robin is the most frequently seen bird in these gardens, followed by the blackbird.
Ohio State scored the most points in the tournament, with 96 in the final alone.
Coughing was the most common symptom in the trial (64 of 200 patients), followed by fever.
quiet: Back pain was one complaint among the drivers (38 percent), and some mentioned neck strain.
Germany sent a team of athletes to the games, and they trained in Austria.
Wheat is grown in the province, and farmers also plant barley and oats.
Lisbon had many tourist visits last year, and hotels were often full.
Theft was reported in the district (52 cases), and police added patrols.
The robin is often seen in these gardens, and so is the blackbird.
Ohio State scored points in the tournament, and the fans cheered loudly.
Coughing was noted in the trial (64 of 200 patients), and doctors recorded it.
